title: Heavy Rain and Floods Hit India, 66 Dead in Assam Landslides
summary: Heavy rain and floods have hit several states in India, with 66 people killed in landslides in Assam. The Indian Meteorological Department (IMD) has warned of further heavy rainfall in the region. The government has deployed troops to assist in rescue efforts. The situation is dire, with many areas still inaccessible due to flooding.
summary_points: Heavy rain and floods have hit several states in India
66 people killed in landslides in Assam
Indian Meteorological Department (IMD) has warned of further heavy rainfall
Government has deployed troops to assist in rescue efforts
Many areas still inaccessible due to flooding
title_hi: हिमालय के पास बारिश और भूस्खलन, असम में 66 लोगों की मौत
